required_changes: DN0 first. Use retained attribution to avoid rerunning the old diagnostic pair. Record per-frame vote/progress on the current overlay only where needed.
DN1 next. Execute actual owner RED before production edits. Use existing validity and GPU lifetime owners for a narrow fix. Keep complete content and coverage proof before present.
DN2. Evaluate exact pressure rebuild and RAF spacing separately. Implement an additional narrow work reduction only when actual-owner RED proves a safe same-output opportunity.
DN3/DN4. Qualify both immediate gestures and final state on the fixed scenario with matching ordinary SDKs. Preserve per-build quantitative provenance.

production: runtime/render/src/skia_renderer.cpp, navigation_pixel_validity.*, navigation_source_snapshot.* and skia_navigation_tiles.* for the evidenced retained-image / exposure / handoff defect.
Existing private pressure coverage, prepared geometry or cache code in runtime/render/src for evidenced exact work reuse (DN2) or dependencies of DN1. No new cross-cutting owners.

CanvasEditingRuntime::serviceNavigationPresentation and RuntimeCompositionCore::serviceFrameOpportunity only if actual route evidence requires a local handoff change. Compile-time private diagnostics where necessary.
verification: Focused native cases under runtime/render/tests or runtime/composition/tests and CMake registration.
New private runners under verification/runners/g5/dpr4_postup_navigation and task-scoped result/output directories. Reference existing immutable corpora and dependency stores.

preserve: Accepted Scene stamp and DPR4 overlay, prior evidence and existing served Demos 4351–4357. Before overwriting an affected watched file/build artifact save its exact preimage or build in a new directory. Bind proofs to preimages.
Public JS/Windows API, OperationEngine and Scene state ownership, exact canonical receipt, viewport/camera isolation, target/context invalidation, ResourceLease and real GPU completion.
Existing pressure and mask command allowances, cache budgets 512/1024/128 MiB, installed locked Semantic/Skia. No budget or idle/heavy matrix expansion.
forbidden_changes: No fictitious progress via extra present/RAF or stale/partial pixels, speculative cache, whole r3 overlay import, prewarm requirement, worker/thread migration, new SDK API or screenshot-only proof.
No commit/push/tag, changing user served SDK, modifying dependency locks or unrelated refactor.
blocking_evidence: DN2 attribution and proof of any change
corroborative: hardware or physical latencies when measured

terminal_success.criteria: Evidence and reviewed candidate from DN0–DN4. A remaining exact latency may be reported as a performance finding with measured decomposition. If active-gesture correctness is only native or only one ordinary lane is resolved, label the Web limitation explicitly and do not claim full feedback closure.

blocked_return: Continue all actionable in-scope work. Return exact evidence, remaining limitation, whether any candidate may be tried, and the smallest next action. An intermediate implementation or sample checkpoint is progress only.
